description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order that no trade or supplier including a distributor, shall sell, expose offer or display for sale white sugar unpacked Rs. 100.00 kg packed Rs. 105.00 kg - Order that no importer shall sell, expose, offer or display for sale or supply for sale given maximum wholesale price for white sugar Rs. 92.00 kg
reasoning: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail and wholesale prices for sugar, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for traders and importers. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to create binding regulations.
